Title: Announcing Public Preview of Query editor in Azure Monitor Metrics

Body.Content:
Public Preview of Query editor in Azure Monitor Metrics is now Available!

We're excited to announce the Public Preview of Query Editor in Azure Metric Explorer through Azure Monitor Workspace (AMW). With this update, customers can directly query promotheus metrics using PromQL within their Azure Monitor workspace. This empowers users to efficiently explore and analyze their metric data by writing PromQL queries directly in Metric Explorer, gaining valuable insights to optimize their resources and enhance performance.
